The petitioner has approached this Court seeking a direction to respondents 1 to 5 to disburse the amount paid as consideration to the 6th respondent as per Document No. 2333/2019 of Chevayur Sub Registry to the petitioner within a time frame to be stipulated by this Court and without prejudice to her right to get a fair compensation under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013.

sentences.text:
2. A counter affidavit has been filed by the 2 nd respondent, wherein paragraph 10 reads as follows:
'10.

It is further submitted that the Deputy Collector Vigilance who has conducted enquiry on the complaint filed by the Petitioner has found that the real owner of the land of 1.27 Ares (0.0127 Hector) registered as per document No.2333/2019 in favour of Government is the Petitioner, Smt. Durga and directed to take necessary action to address police to take action against Ganga Devi and Geetha Devi for cheating the Government by producing false documents and also to take action to recover the amount illegally received by them and to give consideration of this land to Durga immediately.
The District Police Chief had also been requested to file a case against the 6th respondent who illegally received the consideration of the land and for causing heavy loss to Government.

True copy of the letter to the District Police Chief is produced herewith and marked as Exhibit R2(a), Action is being taken to recover the amount paid to Gangadevi and Geethadevi by proceedings under Revenue Recovery Act.
A Revenue Recovery demand notice was issued and served in the name of Gangadevi.
True copy of the demand notice issued to Gangadevi is produced herewith and marked as Exhibit R2(b).

A local enquiry has been conducted by the Village Officer and the Charge Officer in this case and found that the real owner of 1.27 Ares of land registered as per document No.2333/2019 in favour of Government is the Petitioner.
Steps have been taken to freeze the bank accounts of the defaulting parties in this case.

The Tahsildar has also reported that there are currently no issue in collecting the tax for the balance extent of the land, if the petitioner produces the original document and encumbrance certificate."

3. In the counter affidavit it is admitted by the 2 nd respondent that the Deputy Collector Vigilance has conducted an enquiry on a complaint filed by the petitioner and found that the real owner of the S.Durga vs The Chief Secretary on 11 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17414798/
2 land of 1.27 Ares (0.0127 Hector) registered as per document No.2333/2019 in favour of Government is the Petitioner and has issued necessary direction to address the police to take action against the 6th respondent and one Geetha Devi for cheating the Government by producing false documents and also to take action to recover the amount illegally received by them and to give consideration of this land to the petitioner immediately.

4. Since it is admitted that the petitioner is the real owner of the property and she is entitled for the amount towards acquisition of land, I am of the view that the Government cannot wait till recovery of the amount from the 6 th respondent for payment of the amount legally due to the petitioner.

Therefore, there will be a interim direction to respondents 1 to 3 to see that the amount legally due to the petitioner towards acquisition as stated in paragraph 10 of the counter affidavit, is disbursed to the petitioner within an outer limit of four months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
